name: Birgitzköpflhaus
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to the Birgitzköpflhaus in Tirol! Nestled high above the Inn Valley, the Birgitzköpplhaus offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Zillertal Alps and the Kaisergebirge.
beschreibung: The Birgitzköpflhaus in the Axamer Lizum / Innsbruck region is an alpine lodge nestled amidst striking mountain scenery. Catering to winter sports enthusiasts and summer mountaineers, it serves comforting Tyrolean favorites and hot refreshments. The panoramic deck provides breathtaking vistas of the Kalkkögel peaks, making it an idyllic rest point for high-alpine adventures in Tirol.
